# Buffer repository instructions

The only current product authority is `docs/V12_1_PRODUCT_CONTRACT.md`. Read `AGENTS.md`, `PRODUCT.md`, `PROJECT_REQUIREMENTS.md`, and `DESIGN.md` before analyzing or changing the product.

The public repository is a single current snapshot containing only the V12 direct baseline and V12.1 current product evidence. V2-V11 product documents, retired screenshots, tests, scripts, implementations, branches, tags, and readable history were removed from GitHub and exist only in an owner-held offline Git bundle. Never merge external historical context into the current product shape.

Current shape: one real user; four primary spaces (Now, Future, Conditions, Records); REALITY, FORECAST, and SCENARIO are separate; Buffer reflects and never advises. The LLM can only interpret candidate facts. Code validates, the user confirms, and only code commits. V12.1 is complete; do not start OCR, bank sync, AI Chat, Final Hardening, V13, public deployment, or a new product module without an explicit new product decision from the user.
